AGO.note: No link to the civil register stated.
Coverage is called low with no count or share.
Allegations of a foreign firm's control, with no statement of who operates or maintains the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Diario dos Negocios, republishing Imparcial Press, says a 2021 presidential despacho authorised over USD 63 million for production of identity cards and biometric equipment, and that national civil identification coverage remains low four years on.
